# Zensys

> Zensys is a Chennai-based software company, founded in 2008, that implements payroll software (on-premises and cloud), bulk SMS platforms and Bigin by Zoho CRM for businesses across India. It is an authorized Zoho partner and has completed 200+ payroll installations, with a particular focus on the automobile and manufacturing sector.

- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 97909 24330
- Email: info@zensys.in
- Address: INNOV8 SKCL Tech Square, No. 14, Lawsar Street, South Phase, 2nd Floor, SIDCO Industrial Estate, Guindy, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, 600032
- Founded: 2008

## Products and services

- [On-premises payroll software](https://zensys.in/service/payroll-software-on-premises/): On-premises payroll software with biometric time office, leave, employee self-service and PF, ESI, PT, TDS compliance. 200+ installations since 2008. Chennai, Tamil Nadu.
- [Cloud payroll and HRMS software](https://zensys.in/service/cloud-based-software/): Cloud payroll and HRMS software: mobile attendance, leave, appraisals, onboarding, full and final settlement and statutory compliance, accessible from anywhere.
- [Bulk and transactional SMS](https://zensys.in/service/sms-software/): Bulk SMS, OTP and transactional SMS for businesses in Chennai and across India. API integration with CRM and ERP, delivery reports and 24/7 support. SMS services since 2007.
- [Bigin by Zoho CRM implementation](https://zensys.in/service/bigin-by-zoho-crm/): Bigin by Zoho CRM implementation by Zensys, an authorized Zoho partner in Chennai. Pipelines, WhatsApp and email integration, automation, data migration and training.
- [Zoho partner services](https://zensys.in/services/zoho-authorized-partner-in-chennai/): Zensys is an authorized Zoho partner in Chennai. We implement Bigin by Zoho CRM and connect it with payroll and SMS, with migration, training and ongoing support.
